arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ،
transliteration: allāhumma yā man bi-raḥmatihi yastaghīthu al-mudhnibūn
english_text: O God, O He through whose Mercy sinners seek aid!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ إلَى ذِكْرِ إحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ،
transliteration: wayā man ilā dhikri iḥsānihi yafzaʿu almuḍṭarrūn
english_text: O He to the remembrance of whose beneficence the distressed flee!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لِخِيفَتِهِ يَنْتَحِبُ الْخَاطِئُونَ،
transliteration: wa yā man likhīfatihī yantahibu al-khāṭiʾūn
english_text: O He in fear of whom the offenders weep!

arabic_text: يَا اُنْسَ كُلِّ مُسْتَوْحِشٍ غَرِيبٍِ،
transliteration: yā unsa kulli mustawḥišin ġarībin
english_text: O Comfort of every lonely stranger!

arabic_text: وَيَا فَرَجَ كُلِّ مَكْرُوبٍ كَئِيبٍ،
transliteration: wa yā faraja kulli makrūbin ka'ībin
english_text: O Relief of all who are downcast and distressed!

arabic_text: وَيَا غَوْثَ كُلِّ مَخْذُوَلٍ فَرِيدٍ،
transliteration: wayā ghawtha kulli makhdhūlin farīdin
english_text: O Aid of everyone abandoned and alone!

arabic_text: وَيَا عَضُدَ كُلِّ مُحْتَاجٍ طَرِيدٍ .
transliteration: wayā ʿaḍuda kulli muḥtājin ṭarīd
english_text: O Support of every needy outcast!

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً، وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق فِي نِعَمِكَ سَهْماً،
transliteration: ʾanta alladhī wasiʿta kulla shayʾin raḥmatan wa ʿilmā waanta alladhi jaʿalta li-kulli makhluqin fi niʿamika sahman
english_text: Thou art He who "embracest everything in mercy and knowledge"! (40:7) Thou art He who hast appointed for each creature a share of Thy favours!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ،
transliteration: wa-anta allathii `afwuhu a`laa min `iqaabih
english_text: Thou art He whose pardon is higher than His punishment!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ،
transliteration: wa-anta-alladhi tasʿa rahmatuhu amaama ghadabihi
english_text: Thou art He whose mercy runs before His wrath!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي عَطَآؤُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ،
transliteration: waanta alladhi ʿataaʾuhu aktharu min manʿihi
english_text: Thou art He whose bestowal is greater than His withholding!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلاَئِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي رَحمَتِهِ،
transliteration: wa anta alladhī atsāʿa al-khalāʾiqu kulluhum fī raḥmatihi
english_text: Thou art He by whose mercy all creatures are embraced!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يَرْغَبُ فِي جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ،
transliteration: wa anta alladhi la yarghabu fi jazai man a'tahu
english_text: Thou art He who desires no repayment by him upon whom He bestows!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يُفْرِطُ فِي عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ.
transliteration: wa-anta alladhi la yufritu fi 'iqabi man 'asahu
english_text: Thou art He who does not overdo the punishment of him who disobeys Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَنَا يَا إلهِي عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعاءِ فَقَالَ: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
transliteration: wa ana ya ilahi 'abduka alladhi amartahu biddu'a'i faqala: labbayka wa sa'dayka, hā anā dhā yā rabbī maṭrūḥun bayna yadayka
english_text: And I, my God, am Thy servant whom Thou commanded to supplicate and who said: I am at Thy service and disposal! Here am I, my Lord, thrown down before Thee.

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي أَوْقَرَتِ الْخَطَايَا ظَهْرَهُ،
transliteration: anā lladhī awqarati al-khaṭāyā ẓahrhu.
english_text: I am he whose back offenses have weighed down!

arabic_text: وَأَنا الَّذِي أَفْنَتِ الذُّنُوبُ عُمْرَهُ،
transliteration: wa ana allathi afnati aldhunubu ʿumruhu
english_text: I am he whose lifetime sins have consumed!

arabic_text: وَأَنَا الَّذِي بِجَهْلِهِ عَصاكَ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَهْلاً مِنْهُ لِذَاكَ.
transliteration: wa anā alladhī bi jahlihī ʿaṣāka wa lam takun ahlan minhu lidhāk
english_text: I am he who was disobedient in his ignorance, while Thou didst not deserve that from him!

arabic_text: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: hal ʾanta yā ʾilāhī rāḥimun man daʿāka faʾubliga fī al-duʿāʾi
english_text: Wilt Thou, my God, be merciful toward him who supplicates Thee, that I should bring my supplication before Thee?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِي الْبُكَاءِ
transliteration: am anta ghāfirun liman bakāka fausriʿa filbukāʾi
english_text: Wilt Thou forgive him who weeps to Thee that I should hurry to weep?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَنْتَ مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلاً
transliteration: am anta mutajāwizun ʿamman ʿaffara laka wajhahu tadhallulan
english_text: Wilt Thou show forbearance toward him who puts his face in the dust before Thee in lowliness?

arabic_text: أَم أَنْتَ مُغْن مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلاً؟
transliteration: am 'anta mughni man shaka ilayka faqrah, tawakkulan?
english_text: Wilt Thou free from need him who complains to Thee of his indigent need with confidence?

arabic_text: إلهِي لاَ تُخيِّبْ مَنْ لا يَجدُ مُعْطِياً غَيْرَكَ، وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لا يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ.
transliteration: ilāhī lā tukhīb man lā yajid muʿṭīyan ghayraka walā takhzul man lā yastaghni ʿanka bi-aḥadin duunak
english_text: My God, disappoint not him who finds no bestower other than Thee, and abandon not him who cannot be freed from his need for Thee through less than Thee!

arabic_text: إلهِي فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ ، وَلا تَحْرِمْنِي وَقَـدْ رَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ، وَلا تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدْ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
transliteration: ilāhī faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wala tuʿrid ʿanni waqad aqbaltu ʿalayk wa lā taḥrimnī wa qad raghibtu ilayk walā tajbahni birraddi waqad intaṣabtu bayna yadayka
english_text: My God, so bless Muhammad and his Household, turn not away from me when I have turned my face toward Thee, deprive me not when 1 have besought Thee, and slap not my brow with rejection when I have stood before Thee!

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَصَفْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَارْحَمْنِي،
transliteration: anta alladhi wasafta nafsaka bir-rahmah fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa arḥamnī
english_text: Thou art He who has described Himself by mercy, so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالعَفْوِ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
transliteration: wa anta alladhi sammayta nafsaka bil-'afwi, fa'fu 'anni
english_text: Thou art He who has named Himself by pardon so pardon me!

arabic_text: قَـدْ تَرَى يَـا إلهِي فَيْضَ دَمْعِي مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ، وَوَجِيبَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَانْتِفَاضَ جَوَارِحِي مِنْ هَيْبَتِكَ،
transliteration: qad tarā yā ilāhī fayḍa damʿī min khīfatika wa wajība qalbī min khashyatika wa antifāḍa jawāriḥī min haybatika
english_text: Thou hast seen, my God, the flow of my tears in fear of Thee, the throbbing of my heart in dread of Thee, and the infirmity of my limbs in awe of Thee.

arabic_text: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ حَيآءً مِنِّي لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي،
transliteration: kullu dhalika ḥayāʾan minnī li-suʾi ʿamalī
english_text: All this from my shame before Thee because of my evil works!

arabic_text: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِي عَنِ الْجَارِ إلَيْكَ، وَكَلَّ لِسَانِي عَنْ مُنَاجَاتِكَ
transliteration: walidhāka khamada ṣawtī ʿani al-jāri ilayk wa kalla lisānī ʿan munājātika
english_text: So my voice has become silent, no longer crying to Thee, and my tongue has gone dumb, no longer whispering in prayer.

arabic_text: يَا إلهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَكَم مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَم تَفْضَحْنِي،
transliteration: yā ʾilāhī falaka al-ḥamdu, fakam min ʿāʾibatin sataratahā ʿalayya falama tafḍa
english_text: My God, so to Thee belongs praise! How many of my flaws Thou hast covered over without exposing me!
